notes: Adam7 is supported (not refused): each of the 7 passes is unfiltered with the existing reverseFilters and scattered into the full image, bit-packed for depths below 8. Interlace method other than 0/1, and compression/filter method other than 0, throw the existing .invalidIHDR (no new error case). Tests in W3C PNG Boundary Tests.swift build IDAT with a stored-deflate zlib helper; deinterlace was checked standalone with swiftc on 8-bit 3x3, 1-bit 2x2 and a truncated stream.
